featured_reviews.name: Vimal Dubey
featured_reviews.review_text:
The biggest issue is the deposit refund. The owner does not return the full deposit and creates unnecessary problems during the process. In my case, only around 60% of the deposit was returned, and the remaining amount was deducted without any clear or valid explanation. Charges were applied arbitrarily, which felt unfair.

I had to call more than 30 times just to get updates on my deposit, and many times the owner did not even pick up the calls. This made the whole process very frustrating and unprofessional.

Major suggestion: do not leave the PG until your full deposit is returned, as it becomes very difficult to recover the remaining amount later.

The PG had basic amenities and was manageable for staying, but there were several issues. Initially, there were problems with filtered water and the AC, which caused inconvenience. Although the owner fixed these after complaints, it took time and effort to get them resolved. Cleaning was done daily, which is a positive point, but there were still cockroaches in the kitchen, which was not hygienic.

featured_reviews.name: Alan K M
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 5 Stars of Disgrace – Seva Niketan

This is by far the worst place I have ever stayed. The staff openly smoke, drink, and use weed in areas where they know there are no cameras. Rooms are never cleaned — they’re filthy, unhygienic, and the beds are infested with bed bugs.

The lady at the front desk seems more interested in picking fights than helping guests. They allow cops and GST officers to walk in at any hour, but paying guests are locked out if they return late. Even after taking your money, they won’t open the gate or show basic courtesy.

The bathrooms are always clogged and dirty, and the canteen is outright disgusting — you can see rats running around the kitchen. It’s shocking that a place run under Christian management treats guests with such disrespect and neglect.

To make things worse, they refuse to provide any proper proof of payment — no bills, no receipts, nothing.

A completely mismanaged, unhygienic, and unsafe place. Stay away.

featured_reviews.review_text: I had a very good experience staying at Sharad PG. All the amenities were available and well maintained, which made my stay comfortable and hassle free. featured_reviews.name: Naman Kedia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Pros:
1. Office, food options, malls, pvr(phoenix Mall), local stores, railway station, monorail station,etc. all were at just 5-10 minutes of walk.

2. Flat had everything installed including AC, beds, almirah, fans, 2 western bathrooms, fridge, induction, washing machine, water filter, geyser, wifi. No shortage of water or electricity supply.

3. One can also enjoy all the festivals at this prime location. Ganesh Chaturthi(Lalbaug is nearby), Janmashtami, Navratri,etc. It's really happening and vibrant in that part of Mumbai.

Cons:
1. One issue was of disturbance due to noise of trains especially in work from home, though one may get used to it. At a point one may even enjoy passing of trains.

2. Other issue might be of rats near building and a few times dirt/trash did came through window.

3. If you are bachelor, budget might be an issue

Overall it was a good experience.

featured_reviews.name: Secondary Second
featured_reviews.review_text: Very irresponsible staff. My things and money went missing and even though the culprit was caught, they took zero responsibility and action. This hostel is old and unhygienic( photos attached). Better not make the mistake of coming here and losing your deposit as well. They have very absurd rules that you have to follow. The rent is 10k and headaches are complimentary.

featured_reviews.name: Aiswarya J.N
featured_reviews.review_text: My friend had stayed at this hostel for a few months. This is the worst place to stay in this area. It might feel reasonable at first, but it will cost you your peace of mind. The people here are very annoying and illogical. They create too much drama and noise and the little free time that is left after work will be ruined. The rooms are not maintained at all and has not been painted in years. There are some part of the concrete ceiling that has fallen down which could have been fatal. There will also be rats running around this hostel in some seasons. The inmates are given a bed in this congested rooms without even a proper table or chairs. The situation during summers is unbearable. The worst part is the owners are completely unbothered by these complaints and will keep giving silly excuses or will ask the person to leave if they have problems.

featured_reviews.name: Pranjali Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: One of my friends stayed here and this is the worst place to stay in Mumbai. Hostel owners are pathetic and rude to the girls always. They make up silly rules which are illogical and the wardens will make your life hell if you confront them about anything wrong with their hostel. The hostel building is also very old. Some door locks are not proper, rats run around in the dining area, fridge provided is of no use, even few fans are not working, and they don't take proper responsibility in fixing any of these problems. You have to fight with them for getting basic facilities for which you are already paying. Also, they don't even allow you to go in any other room. That place feels like a jail. Everyone is asked to switch off the lights at 10:30 pm which is stupid. They will ask you to pay extra if you want to use the lights for studying after curfew. Hostel wardens are the worst, Please do not make the mistake of coming here. I hope there was an option for negative rating

featured_reviews.name: Akhil Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: We had checked this hostel out  for my sister who was moving to Mumbai, but this hostel was like from the 90s. It says working women’s but they treat them like kids. The set of rules that exist here makes no sense except to save money for them. The curfew is till 10: 30 pm and the lights need to be switched off at 10:30 even if you have work or any imp issues. They are not allowed to go outside after having dinner which is roughly 8 pm. They even have rules controlling the way they should dress. They were also asking to pay extra for electricity if they happen to stay here at day time and even ask them to turn off the lights in their room. The rule to get back the deposit is also not reasonable and it’s mostly gone.  Some of the inmates had mentioned that it gets too noisy on sundays. They make up rules once you join which they had not mentioned before.

featured_reviews.name: faseeh kp
featured_reviews.review_text: I have heard only bad things about this hostel and their management. The people here have not evolved in 40 years and have the same rules that were applied to in the Stone Age. There is no point in arguing with them since that requires a minimum common sense. The area is good to live in but these people will make it a living hell. They treat the inmates like kids and interfere in their personal matters.

featured_reviews.name: Nikhila Nixon
featured_reviews.review_text: Not a safe place to stay. The staff here are very irresponsible about the safety of girls. There is no guarantee of your valuables and belongings. They provide only a very small shelf for each person which is not enough for the basic things you have. I have also heard that things get stolen from this hostel and the staff take no preventive measures or responsibility. They are also not cooperative at all.

featured_reviews.name: Anjali Suresh
featured_reviews.review_text: Worst place to stay.Mine and my roommate‘s belongings, money and purse had gone missing. Some of it were caught in a girl’s shelf and they did absolutely nothing. I kept asking them to change rooms or do something for over 2 months and they said that if I had that much problem i should leave. They kept defending the one whole stole the things. They kept making silly excuses because they would rather keep a girl who steals  than keep somebody who complained about it. I’m not sure what extra money they were taking from her. They would eat your brain alive with their illogical explanations. If you ever find yourself near their gate, please do yourself a favour and run in the opposite direction.

Orthodox sisters and worst mentality. Right from watchman to the maid everyone is rude and shameless. Sisters dominate you completely and also too much interference in what you wear, where you go & what you do. Girls around spread rumours and a lot of discrimination if you are not a christian. In the name of God they blackmail you and make you live their way. There is mandatory Christian prayer after dinner(attendance gets tracked) No plug points in the rooms. The electricity switch gets off by 10.30pm. Mandatory irritating useless seminars every now and then.
Food and cleanliness is okay. They make you clean kitchen sinks as per your roll no. Not a welcoming place for sure. Overall, this hostel is a torture!!

featured_reviews.name: Dcosta Chrismita
featured_reviews.review_text: I found my home away from home with Yuvati Sharan! I have found a family at my hostel. Anyday is not a rough day for when I am back I have my room mates who could lighten up my mood. The sisters at the Hostel ensure you are having a lovely day everyday. I wish I could have stayed for a longer span but I am sure of carrying memories throughout my life

featured_reviews.name: Melinda Pereira
featured_reviews.review_text:
I stayed in this hostel for about 8 months. Yuvathi sharan is the best hostel in a crowded city  like mumbai. It is calm ,clean and serene. This hostel provides all basic emmenities for a best price which suits to pockets.
The administration is helpful and caring. Sister Magdalene and Sister irene were caring and heartful people i met in the hostel.At the same time they were strict with girls who were indisciplined. The hostel has certain rules related to timings and behaviour which making it a good place to live. The food is nice and special attention is given to cleanliness. there is rollcall everyday followed by a small prayer nominal to all religion and faiths. All girls were also nice. I miss the festival celebrations, secret santa and fresher party. As i was preparing for a exam during my stay this hostel provided agood environment which i would have not got in other pgs in mumbai.

If anybody wants  a safe home like place in mumbai,  with good rules and regulations then this is the best place.

featured_reviews.name: Aman Saiyed
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good hostel with ample facilities. Mess is also available here. The rooms here consists of 4 bed, 6bed, 9bed, and 15 beded.
The rooms are cleaned daily by the cleaners, moreover it is located at the prime location of CSMT and marine drive is also very close to it .
Security is quiet good and the passages are equipped with camera's. Admission first preference is given to the Anjuman Students and then the other institute students.though they serve only breakfast and dinner but the quality of the food is excellent. Also, 4 days in a week they serve Chicken in dinner and milk everyday. The hostel warden is quiet supportive and understanding. The rooms are WIFI enabled and has proper ventilation. The yearly fees varies from 80,000 to 1,05,000 rs. The hostel has got a big study room with proper desk and chairs open 24X7 for studies. Moreover hostel has got a mosque in the campus and a big playground. The hostel has 5 floors and has a capacity of more than 180 students.

featured_reviews.name: Lucksborn Sangma (Lucks)
featured_reviews.review_text: Very good boys hostel to stay. The staff is very friendly and nice. Cleans the rooms every single day and love the food as well. Breakfast and dinner is given except on Sunday where dinner is not given but lunch is. Love the fact that you have be in the hostel only by 11 pm at night even when you go out. There is television to watch, water cooler, greaser to bath. Highly recommend.
